purpose: Isolated research references and benchmark tooling; no external source is silently copied into the production chemistry engine.

repositories.name: OpenGlaze
repositories.integration_status: downloaded; skill installed globally; no source copied into core
repositories.notes: Directly relevant UMF, recipe analysis, CTE estimation and substitution utilities. Results remain independent reference outputs and are not treated as measured truth.

repositories.name: pycalphad
repositories.notes: Requires a provenance-controlled ceramic oxide thermodynamic database (TDB). The library alone cannot predict glaze phases.

repositories.name: GlazyBench
repositories.integration_status: quarantined; not a production training set
repositories.notes: Metadata-only benchmark release. License, dataset lineage and non-commercial terms prevent bundling into a commercial product or model.

repositories.name: LIPGLOSS-CALC
repositories.notes: Useful constrained UMF/linear-programming reference. GPL code is kept outside the application source.

repositories.name: LIPGLOSS2
repositories.notes: CVXOPT-based glaze recipe optimizer reference. Its dependency and GPL boundary are not part of the MVP.

repositories.name: Cantera
repositories.notes: Generic thermochemistry/kinetics toolkit. It has no validated ceramic glaze mechanism or oxide-melt database, so it is not a glaze predictor.

repositories.name: pymatgen
repositories.notes: Useful structure/phase utilities, not a glaze chemistry model. Materials Project records require their own API and data-use review.

repositories.name: matminer
repositories.notes: Feature engineering utilities are relevant only after a rights-filtered, measured dataset and leakage-safe split exist.
